color.note: Brand colours from the Haysam brand book (Ranglar). Rough share in a design: canvas 60, ink 25, white 10, accent 5. One accent per design: yellow or fire. Designs built on a photo take their colours from the photo; Haysam shows only through the logo, tool logos and type. Never lime or acid green.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Lavanda. The default canvas and the top stop of the canvas gradient. Ink text on it reaches 11.4:1.

tokens.name: lavender-white
tokens.usage: Oq-lavanda. Bottom stop of the canvas gradient; board and carousel ground; the near-white canvas. Ink text on it reaches 12.8:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All brand text and the ink logo, on lavender, lavender-white, white and yellow (10.6:1 or more). Also the fill of brand-book pill buttons.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Tun. Dark canvas for night and cinema covers only, paired with the warm comet glow. Never a general dark mode. White text on it reaches 18.9:1.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Sariq. Accent: stickers, pop buttons, the comet's head, pill buttons on night. Ink or night text on it (10.6:1 and 14.6:1). Never yellow text on lavender.

tokens.name: fire
tokens.usage: Olov. Accent: comet trail, selection box and cursor, the chip dot, brand-book eyebrows. Fire on lavender is 3.7:1 and on white 4.4:1, so use it for marks, icons and text 24px or larger; keep small body text in ink.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards and tool-logo tiles on lavender; text, the white logo and the yellow-white logo on night and on photos.

tokens.name: dot-grid
tokens.usage: Dots of the dot-grid pattern and hairlines on the lavender canvas. Decoration only (1.3:1 on lavender), never text.

tokens.name: sky-light
tokens.usage: Offer gradient, first stop. Offers and prices only.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Offer gradient, middle stop. Offers and prices only. Ink or night text on it (7.6:1 and 10.5:1).

tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: Offer gradient, last stop. Offers and prices only. White text on it is 3.9:1: only at 24px or larger.

tokens.name: metal-light
tokens.usage: Ink-metal lettering gradient, last stop: night to ink to metal-light, top to bottom. Gradient headlines only.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page and artboard ground: the top of the lavender gradient, or flat night.

tokens.name: canvas-end
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the canvas gradient (lavender to lavender-white). Night stays flat.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on canvas: ink on lavender, white on night.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Fill of the brand-book pill button: ink on lavender, yellow on night.

tokens.name: on-button
tokens.usage: Label on the pill button: white on ink (13.7:1), ink on yellow (10.6:1).

type.note: Pick ONE mood font per post and change it from post to post. Inter is for chips and labels only. Headlines are big: 110 to 230px on a 1080px canvas, two lines at most, line height 88 to 95 percent. No small meta text. All faces are free Google Fonts under the OFL.

styles.name: headline-brand
styles.usage: Brand mood: the Haysam voice, notes, how-tos. Set in caps.

styles.name: headline-news
styles.usage: News mood: news and loud caps. Set in caps.

styles.name: headline-future
styles.usage: Future mood: tech, numbers, anything new. Unbounded Black.

styles.name: headline-loud
styles.usage: Loud mood: hype and calls to action.

styles.name: headline-cinema
styles.usage: Cinema mood: video, film, process. Big Shoulders Display Black, in caps.

styles.name: headline-premium
styles.usage: Premium mood: personal letters, calm moments. Sentence case.

styles.name: headline-play
styles.usage: Play mood: friendly, community. Bricolage Grotesque ExtraBold.

styles.name: subline
styles.usage: One supporting line under a headline, as in the brand-book carousel. Use the post's mood font or Instrument Serif.

styles.name: sticker-label
styles.usage: Text on a mono sticker. Caps.

styles.name: chip-label
styles.sample: Bir xil ishlarga ko‘p vaqt ketyaptimi?
styles.usage: Chips and labels on a post. The smallest text allowed on a 1080px canvas.

styles.name: lockup-label
styles.usage: Tool name in the HAYSAM x tool lockup.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page and slide titles. Caps, in text colour.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The intro paragraph beside a page title. Bold key words.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Pill-button labels, hex codes, file names.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows above a group, in caps. Fire colour is allowed here only because it is bold caps; otherwise ink.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: One-line notes under a card title. Web and documents only, never on posts.

spacing.note: Measured from the brand book: pages on a 1440px width, posts on a 1080px canvas.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its arrow in a pill; dot-to-text gap in a chip.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and tiles in a grid.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a brand-book card.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Between page sections; between headline and object on a post.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Side margin of a brand-book page and of a 1080px post.

tokens.name: radius-sticker
tokens.usage: Mono stickers.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Brand-book cards, swatches and logo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Tool-logo tiles on a 1080px post.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, chips, the cursor name tag, pop buttons.

shadow.note: Glows use the hue of the element they surround. Never a dark outline, bevel or drop shadow on the logo.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Tool-logo tiles and floating cards on the lavender canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-pop-yellow
tokens.usage: Rim and glow of a yellow pop button.

tokens.name: shadow-pop-fire
tokens.usage: Rim and glow of a fire pop button.

layout.note: Social formats. The master is 1080x1920; the 4:5 feed crop (1080x1350) and the 3:4 profile grid must still work.

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: Width of every post and cover.

tokens.name: story-height
tokens.usage: Reels and Stories cover master (9:16).

tokens.name: feed-height
tokens.usage: Feed post and carousel slide (4:5).

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: Top of the band that holds everything important on a 1080x1920 cover.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the safe band on a 1080x1920 cover.

tokens.name: reels-ui-right
tokens.usage: Reels buttons zone: the right 140px below y 1180. No text there.

tokens.name: reels-ui-from
tokens.usage: Where the right-hand Reels buttons zone starts.

tokens.name: reels-ui-bottom
tokens.usage: Reels caption zone: the bottom 330px. No text there.

tokens.name: logo-height
tokens.usage: Height of the logo lockup on a 1080px-wide canvas, centred near the top.

tokens.name: logo-y
tokens.usage: Vertical position of the logo on a 1080x1920 cover, just inside the safe band.

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the dot grid on a 1080px canvas (4px dots).

tokens.name: line-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the line grid on a 1080px canvas (2px lines).
